interpretation.pilot_direction: Model A exceeded the random-control mean.
interpretation.conclusion: This is a pilot hardware comparison. There is one Model A hardware observation and 10 random controls. Therefore the result should not be described as statistically significant evidence of model superiority. It supports a preliminary directional comparison.

limitations: Only one Model A hardware execution was performed.
Random controls were executed once each.
The experiment used one circuit family.
The current model predicts individual-qubit viability rather than explicit two-qubit gate quality.
The result is a pilot comparison rather than a statistically powered validation.
